title: Options Playbook Radio 239: AAPL Front Spread with Calls
text:
Posted 3 hours ago by Brian Overby in Brokerage Information AAPL Front Spread with Calls Listen to Options Playbook Radio 239: AAPL Front Spread with Calls Now that the Fed has spoken, the market is reacting. This is a good opportunity for a front spread. You can find more in The Options Playbook , which is always available on OptionsPlaybook.com , in on the Amazon Kindle edition. Specifically: The Fed has spoken Using AAPL as an example Where is APPL now? Selecting an expiration date Max risk and max gain Do you have a question that you want answered on a future episode? Send them to Brian at [email protected] , or to the Options Insider at [email protected] . About Brian Overby As Senior Options Analyst for Ally Invest, Brian Overby is a widely sought-after resource for his option trading knowledge and market insights. He has contributed to numerous articles for the Wall Street Journal, Reuters and Bloomberg and has had numerous appearances on CNBC Fast Money and Fox Business News. A veteran of the financial industry since 1992, Brian continually seeks to improve the understanding of the retail investor. He has given thousands of option trading seminars worldwide, written hundreds of articles on investing, and is the author of the popular trading resource, The Options Playbook and it’s free, acclaimed companion site OptionsPlaybook.com. Prior to joining Ally, Brian was a senior staff instructor for the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) and managed the training department for one of the world's largest market makers, Knight Trading Group.
